#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
cd /home/rich/.codex/worktrees/list-index-numeric-5611/Project-Copperfin || exit 1
# Exact observed task-owned fixed-driver PID; no model-turn polling or parallel suites.
tail --pid=222556 --sleep-interval=1 -f /dev/null || exit 2
for task_status in fixed-gcc fixed-clang preservation-gcc preservation-clang; do
 test -f "build/list-index-native/$task_status.status" || exit 3
 test "$(cat "build/list-index-native/$task_status.status")" = 0 || exit 4
done
sha256sum -c tests/fixtures/vfp9-list-index-numeric/fixed.sha256 > build/list-index-native/contracts-before.log || exit 5
export TMPDIR=/home/rich/.codex/worktrees/list-index-numeric-5611/Project-Copperfin/build/list-index-tmp
export COPPERFIN_LOCALE_DIR=/home/rich/.codex/worktrees/list-index-numeric-5611/Project-Copperfin/resources/locales
unset ASAN_OPTIONS UBSAN_OPTIONS
nice -n 10 ionice -c 2 -n 7 ctest --test-dir build/list-index-gcc -V --output-on-failure --timeout 600 -j 1 -R '^(test_contributor_signoff_contract|test_changelog_fragment_assembler|test_changelog_fragments_valid|test_agent_channel_contract|test_safety_traceability_workflow_contract)$' > build/list-index-native/contracts.log 2>&1
task_contract_status=$?
printf '%s\n' "$task_contract_status" > build/list-index-native/contracts.status
date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' > build/list-index-native/contracts.completed-at
test "$task_contract_status" -eq 0 || exit "$task_contract_status"
sha256sum -c tests/fixtures/vfp9-list-index-numeric/fixed.sha256 > build/list-index-native/contracts-after.log || exit 6
